name: control-mode-switch-clears-a-pending-permission
description: An ACP agent is waiting for a permission answer when the person switches to remote mode. The request is dropped unanswered and PowerUp's own session is stopped.
reason: In remote mode Approve and Reject press Enter and Escape in the person's real session. A banner left over from the built-in session would invite a press that lands in the wrong place.
source: AppState.syncControlMode (comment: 'A pending harness permission request belongs to the mode being left')

script.reason: The agent asks to edit a file.
Switch to remote mode with the request still waiting.

transcript.text: The agent wants to: Edit — README.md. Press ✕ to allow or ○ to deny.
Remote control mode — buttons and voice now drive your existing Claude session.
